errors.text_span: Секторите изглеждат подредени по низходящ размер, започвайки от оранжевия сектор и завършвайки с жълтия.
errors.evidence: The description claims the sectors are arranged in descending order of size. However, the visual arrangement of the slices, starting from the top and moving clockwise, is: Blue (22.1%), Orange (42.6%), Gray (23.5%), and Yellow (11.8%). This sequence of values is not in descending order.
